name: Gran Colombia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and red, with the coat of arms in the centre: two cornucopias and a bundle of rods in an oval ringed by the words "República de Colombia" and a green laurel wreath.
flag.symbolism: The yellow, blue and red tricolour was devised by the independence leader Francisco de Miranda and is still shared by Colombia, Ecuador and Venezuela.

hook: Gran Colombia's yellow, blue and red stripes are all the same height with a wreathed oval emblem in the middle; Colombia and Ecuador made the yellow double-height, and Venezuela added an arc of stars.
trivia: Simón Bolívar, who led the wars of independence against Spain, was Gran Colombia's first president.
It broke apart in 1830–1831 into Venezuela, Ecuador and New Granada, which later became Colombia; Panama was part of Colombia until 1903.
